algorithm: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, quantile loss (p10, p50, p90), range calibrated by conformalized quantile regression
intended_use: Suggest a starting price to producers. A human always decides.

training_data.source: Synthetic, generated by ml/dataset.py from reference prices

limitations: Synthetic data: real prices may differ until retrained with SIPSA-DANE data.
Reference prices are per category, not per specific product.
Does not model transport costs or product quality grades.
The coverage guarantee assumes new auctions resemble the calibration data.
